I fixed the one finding this work-item names: `agents/code-scout.md` now tells the researcher it has 80 turns (`--max-turns 80`), as `work run` actually gives it. The change is in commit `2e913069`, and the result file says `DONE`.

- **No red run:** the three scenarios the work-item accepts (r19, r110, r117) were already green before I changed anything. The plan says so too, and no scenario reads the agent text. I did the fix anyway, since the work-item says to fix the findings it names.
- **Runs:** `python3 -m pytest -q -p work_items --work-item w188` gave 146 passed, 1 skipped, 56 subtests passed. `tests/scripts/test_agents.py` gave 8 passed. `tools size --limit 300` printed nothing. I did not run the whole suite. The brief's record for it was 883 passed, 0 failed at start.
- **Not fixed:** I left two open cases in the report for the person. First, whether an empty or whitespace-only question from a gate counts as "gives no question" under r117. Second, the r110 review-and-fix loop has no bound.
- **Report layout:** its `## Size` heading still reads "(see below)". The size result is in the final line after it.

The report is `.shop/scratch/3-implement/report.md`.
